status: DRAFT_FOR_REVIEW - freeze only after reviewer sign-off

status_enum.ANSWERED: every required slot covered by applicable claims
status_enum.ANSWERED_SCOPED: answer is scope-qualified (per-branch or explicit conditions)
status_enum.CONFLICTED: applicable same-scope claims disagree; both returned (not exercised by the 23 official questions)
status_enum.PARTIAL: some required slots covered, others are gaps
status_enum.UNANSWERABLE: a required slot has no applicable claim or the entity cannot be resolved

severity.CRITICAL: wrong entity/number/unit/revision; answering an UNANSWERABLE item; field-note value stated as fact
severity.MAJOR: wrong/missing citation; omitted required element; unflagged scope

assertion_kind.inferred: derived from >=2 evidence items by a named rule; must be labelled

conventions.tier_note: Document tier is descriptive only and never selects a winner; scope/entity relations decide applicability.
conventions.claim_keys: Symbolic, not IDs: graders match on (entity, predicate, scope, value). Claim IDs do not exist before extraction.
conventions.manual_visual_note: Images and the scan have no reliable text layer (OCR misread A17 as 'Al7'). A human must eyeball these.

reviewer_decisions.issue: A grey (hydraulic-fluid) line touches PLC-03 and the HPU. Gold excludes the HPU as control-connected per the legend but requires the caveat. Confirm, or declare the HPU a direct connection.
Gold requires the Auxiliary Reservoir and the excerpt-only caveat; Main Reservoir is also absent from the manuals but treated as optional. Confirm.
ECN-1042's 'manufactured after 2024' is treated as rationale, not a scope condition. Confirm.
'Pressure limit' read as the normal operating setpoint (180 bar), with a note that alarm limits are separate. Confirm.
Marked PARTIAL (480V facts exist, 400V/phase absent) rather than UNANSWERABLE. Confirm.
Mapping is labelled inferred (no document defines the key). Confirm that inferred is acceptable for this intent.
Boundary at exactly 50 bar and the missing Section 8 are recorded as gaps. Confirm.
'Current' resolved via config firmware 3.2.1 + revision history (3.3 unpublished). Confirm that no hard-coded max(version) is intended.

dataset_observations: Package is smaller than task-description.pdf implies (e.g. operator manual is 2 pages; maintenance manual 1 page). Do not hard-code page counts.
Operator Manual has no Sections 3 or 8, yet Section 7 and the Maintenance Manual cite Section 8 (manual bleed procedure). Alarms A01-A16/A20-A34 live in AEG-AL-701, not in the package.

Diagnostics screenshot: if 4-20 mA maps linearly onto the calibrated 0-200 bar span, 14.8 mA is ~135 bar, not the displayed 200.3 bar. Not asked by any question; screenshot values are illustrative and must not be treated as specifications.
No official question expects CONFLICTED. The conflict path must be exercised by held-out/mutation tests (e.g. inject a same-scope contradicting claim).
Naive deskew (minAreaRect on dark pixels) estimated -88 deg on the scan and would have rotated it into garbage: preprocessing must be gated by an OCR-quality check.

traces.gold_answer_summary: Do not reset PLC-03 while hydraulic pressure is above 50 bar (it can cause an uncommanded valve transition, e.g. momentary IV-21 actuation). traces.gold_answer_summary: Cannot be determined.
